title: Personal Credit Cards: requesting a credit limit increase or decrease
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: credit limit increases and decreases

This policy covers credit limit changes requested by the cardholder on the Personal Credit Cards line: who may request an increase and when, how large it may be, and how far a limit may be decreased.

## Increase terms by tier

| Card tier | Increase available after (whole months since opening) | Months required since the last increase | Largest single increase, percent of the current limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | not offered | 6 | not offered |
| College Rewards Visa | 6 | 6 | 25% |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 6 | 6 | 50% |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 6 | 6 | 50% |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 6 | 6 | 50% |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 6 | 6 | 100% |

## Policy clauses

1. A credit limit increase is requested by the cardholder, who must consent to a credit inquiry. It is available only on tiers where it is offered.
2. The account must be active and not past due, as shown by the account's status and days past due in the bank's records.
3. At least the tier's number of whole months must have passed since the account was opened. Months are counted in calendar months from the opening date; the request is eligible when the current date is on or after the opening date plus that number of calendar months.
4. Where the account has a last limit increase date, at least the tier's number of whole months must have passed since that date.
5. The new limit may exceed the current limit by at most the tier's largest single increase percent, may not exceed the tier's largest credit limit, and is subject to the combined credit line cap.
6. A decrease requested by the cardholder is allowed at any time on an active or suspended account, down to the greater of the tier's smallest credit limit and the current balance rounded up to the next whole hundred dollars.
7. Secured Visa limits change only by changing the security deposit, which is outside this policy.

## Boundary cases for the months since opening (hypothetical dates, 6-month tier)

| Account opened | Request date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 15 January | 15 July | eligible: on the opening date plus 6 calendar months |
| 15 January | 14 July | not eligible: one day before that date |
| 15 January | 2 August | eligible: after that date |

## Worked examples (hypothetical accounts)

- A Cash Rewards Visa with a current limit of 4000.00 USD may be raised by at most 50%, to no more than 6000.00 USD, and only within the tier's largest credit limit and the combined cap.
- A decrease on a card with a balance of 1234.56 USD: the balance rounded up to the next whole hundred is 1300.00 USD; on a tier whose smallest limit is below that figure, 1300.00 USD is the lowest limit the decrease may reach.
- A suspended card may be decreased, but not increased: an increase needs an active account that is not past due.
